title: Hardware Setup, Peripherals & Cables: Imperatives & Can
description: Essential English for connecting monitors, docking stations, network cables, and basic reboot instructions.
learning_objectives: Give basic IT support instructions (plug in, restart, connect)
Use modal 'can' and 'can't' for hardware compatibility
Avoid basic Czech word order mistakes in IT inquiries

questions.prompt: Please _____ your laptop and check if the Wi-Fi connects.

explanations.correct: Polite imperative after 'Please' uses base form 'reboot'.

questions.cz_learning_point: Czech 'Prosím restartujte...'. In English, say 'Please reboot / Please restart'.

questions.prompt: You _____ connect this external monitor using an HDMI cable.
questions.cz_learning_point: Never say *can to connect*. Always say 'You can connect'.

questions.prompt: Do not _____ the USB flash drive while the file transfer is in progress!

explanations.correct: Negative imperative 'Do not' requires base verb 'disconnect'.

questions.cz_learning_point: Czech 'Neodpojujte flash disk'. Use 'Do not disconnect'.

questions.prompt: The service desk technician _____ all incoming P3 tickets within four hours.

explanations.correct: Singular subject 'The technician' takes 'assigns' with third person '-s'.

questions.cz_learning_point: Czech 'Technik přiřazuje'. Third person singular in English requires '-s': 'assigns'.
questions.workplace_track: ITIL Global Service Desk & Incident Escalation

questions.prompt: Where _____ the network Ethernet cable connected?

explanations.correct: Singular subject 'cable' takes 'is' with passive participle 'connected'.

questions.cz_learning_point: Czech 'Kde je zapojen kabel?'. Singular subject $ightarrow$ 'Where is the cable connected?'.

questions.prompt: Users _____ never share their Windows login passwords with anyone.

explanations.correct: Modal 'must' is followed directly by bare verb 'share' ('must never share').

questions.cz_learning_point: Never say *must to*. Always use 'must never share'.

questions.prompt: The user _____ not remember their corporate VPN password.

explanations.correct: Singular subject 'The user' takes 'does not remember'.

questions.cz_learning_point: Czech 'Uživatel si nepamatuje'. In English: 'does not remember'.
questions.workplace_track: ITIL Global Service Desk & Incident Escalation

questions.prompt: Please plug the docking station power adapter _____ the wall outlet.

explanations.correct: 'Plug into' is the fixed phrasal verb for electrical connectors entering an outlet.
explanations.wrong_B: 'to' is incomplete for plugging into an outlet.

questions.cz_learning_point: Czech 'zapojit do zásuvky'. In English: 'plug into the wall outlet'.

questions.prompt: Both cloud server instances _____ currently running in the Azure North Europe region.
questions.cz_learning_point: Czech 'Oba servery běží'. Plural subject takes 'are running'.

questions.prompt: Can you _____ me your employee ID number so I can unlock your account?

explanations.correct: Modal question 'Can you' is followed by the bare infinitive 'give'.
explanations.wrong_A: Third person '-s' is invalid after modal 'can'.

questions.cz_learning_point: Czech 'Můžete mi dát...?'. Never say *Can you to give me*. Use 'Can you give me...?'.
questions.workplace_track: ITIL Global Service Desk & Incident Escalation
